description: 防災資訊河川警戒 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 經濟部水利署災害緊急應變小組，運用長期防災應變等相關經驗，進一步結合雨量、水位、水庫等即時資料，透過電腦科技的運算，提供民眾與相關單位水位警戒。 讓民眾了解居家淹水風險，及早準備，降低災害的發生。 本資料集係連結到KML(Keyhole Markup Language)檔案清冊，該格式是基於XML（eXtensible Markup La... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
